$F=\frac{k·q_{1}·q_{2}}{r^{2}}$

$\epsilon_{0}=8.854·10^{-12} [\frac{F}{m}]$ electric costant

# Task 3
![[Pasted image 20261026153350.png]]
$r=26.5\cdot 10^{-12}m$
$q=2e$
$e=1.602·10^{-19}$

$F=\frac{k·q_{1}·q_{2}}{r^{2}}$
$\boxed{\vec{E}=\frac{\vec{F}}{q} \left[ \frac{N}{C} \right]}$

$\vec{E} = \dfrac{1}{4 \pi \epsilon_0} \sum_{i=1}^N \dfrac{q_i}{r_i^2} \hat{r}_i. \nonumber$
$\vec{E}=k· \frac{q}{r^{2}}$
$\vec{E}=8.99·10^{9}· \frac{2·1.602·10^{-19}}{(26.5·10^{-12})^{2}}=4.10×10^{12}\left[ \frac{N}{C} \right]$
